verified_findings.exact_support: This dataset contains 63,629 HVAC objects from 110 CAD drawings.
verified_findings.finding: AHMsys reports one BIM-project dataset of 110 CAD drawings and 63,629 HVAC objects.
verified_findings.applicability_limit: Single-project object/model generation results do not establish raw heterogeneous-plan takeoff accuracy.

verified_findings.title: AHMsys: An Automated HVAC Modeling System for BIM Project - arXiv
verified_findings.exact_support: A reference node, designed as an equilateral triangle with dimensions of 500x500x500mm, is placed at a known coordinate or the origin of the CAD drawing.
verified_findings.finding: AHMsys relies on an added reference node for scale, alongside prescribed preprocessing and nearby dimension text.
verified_findings.applicability_limit: These are this study's preparation assumptions, not an admission rule for arbitrary drawings or a replacement for approved scale evidence.

verified_findings.exact_support: 120 high-quality floor plans (doors, windows, bedrooms, toilets)
verified_findings.finding: AECV-Bench separates counting four architectural classes from drawing-grounded question answering.
verified_findings.applicability_limit: Its 120-plan counting task and 192 QA pairs are not representative HVAC duct-length or air-device-count acceptance.

verified_findings.finding: The paper reports a historical study of 313,647 public Spaces repositories from March 2022 through December 2024, finding 9,149 affected repositories and 11,557 unique exposed keys. It reports exposure in current files and commit history.
verified_findings.applicability_limit: Historical author-reported aggregate research, not a present-day audit of this notebook, the owner, any account, or any credential. No credential search, extraction, validation or account access was conducted.

verified_findings.title: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Secret Keys Leakage in Hugging Face Spaces - Yuchao Zhang
verified_findings.finding: The paper recommends dedicated secret storage, preventing accidental sensitive-file commits and rotating exposed credentials; removing a current-file value alone does not remove historical exposure.
verified_findings.applicability_limit: This task performs none of the paper's discovery, validation or repository-remediation procedures. Any history rewrite, account change or credential action requires separate explicit scope.
